svg.title: Malaysia Price Watch
svg.desc: Malaysia Price Watch: 21,039,347 grocery prices from PriceCatcher, cleaned with 7 quality checks and modelled as a star schema in PostgreSQL to answer 31 business questions. Findings shown: the same 265-item basket cost RM 4,349.65 in Kuala Lumpur and RM 3,959.53 in Kedah; 8 everyday staples cost RM 99.45 at wet markets and RM 88.76 at hypermarkets; on 181 items sold in all five shop types the price index was 95.0 at hypermarkets and 104.3 at sundry shops.

g.text: The same basket cost 9.9% more in Kuala
Everyday staples cost 12.0% more at wet
One unit of each of 8 staples, September 2026
